verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks (REST/Graph CRUD on folders, files and driveItems) and a community note that internal sharing via Active Directory groups is simple. Nothing documents view-only sharing links, download controls, or visibility into who accessed diligence materials, so the data-room capability itself is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a lightweight data room — organized shared folders with view-only links, download controls, and access visibility for diligence
